subject: Governance at 39, and what is safe to ship
body:
Tomas,

Your Playline Games assessment put governance at 39, below the median among gaming organisations that have completed it (n=38). Tooling came out at 71, so adoption is not the problem.

That lines up with what you wrote, that your engineers use AI daily but nobody can tell you what is safe to ship. On these numbers it reads as a decision framework gap rather than a tooling gap.

Nebius Academy is the education and research hub of Nebius, an AI cloud company, and the material is taught by practitioners who run AI in production.

Open to 20 minutes on where that line should sit for your 120 engineers?

Adam
